purpose: Evaluation-resolution check before any formal full search (maintainer amendment 2026-10-18): does eval-set-1's fluid_reasoning_720 resolve models in the student's capacity range? Measures (a) Qwen3-0.6B, the released model with exactly the student geometry, at its own configured context in its native thinking mode, and (b) two EXISTING recovered checkpoints that extend the recovery-dose ladder already measured on this set (0.86M x2: 0/720; 2.96M: 10/720) to 1.60M and 5.50M. No training; nothing is the formal endpoint.

teacher._why_here: the shared setup stages the teacher; no run in this plan uses it

references.label: qwen3_0p6b
references.role: released Qwen3-0.6B: identical parameter geometry to the student (28 x 1024, 16/8 heads, FFN 3072, vocab 151,936), full pre- and post-training; the same-geometry anchor for what this battery can resolve at student scale
references.context: configured max_position_embeddings (40,960) minus the prompt, per P18

students.label: e1_r1600k_sa_pca
students.role: E1 KD-heavy 1.60M rung, seed sa (positional PCA init, recipe family of the fixed 0.86M recipe)

students.label: e1_r5500k_sa_pca
students.role: E1 KD-heavy 5.50M rung, seed sa: the most-recovered existing student

already_measured_on_this_set.not_repeated: complete valid measurements are never re-run (P12.1)

gpu_why: the previous battery session's measured per-student rates (13-19 min per 720 on this card) price this one; a 40,960-token reference context fits either card, and the A100 keeps the students' numbers on the hardware they were first measured on
decision_use: descriptive resolution evidence for the formal Stage-0 design's sequential resolution gate; it neither replaces nor pre-judges the formal 1x recovery measurement of a D1-initialized student
run_order_why: the same-geometry reference is the decision-relevant anchor, so it runs first; then the most-recovered student; a hard stop can only cost the last unit, and every finished unit is secured off-pod as it completes
